newsitem.title: USA: Magnum Petroleum acquires Texas oil well.
newsitem.headline: Magnum Petroleum acquires Texas oil well.

text.p: Magnum Petroleum Inc said Wednesday that it has completed acquiring 100 percent working interest in a producing well in Eastland County, Texas.
Magnum said it bought the well from a private company for $850,000 cash.

Magnum said the well is producing 48 barrels of oil per day and 183,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day. Future net revenues from the well excluding any behind-pipe reserves are estimated to be $3.4 million with a present worth, discounted at 10 percent, of $1,832,307 using current prices for the estimated 25-year-life of the property, Magnum said.
The well is generating monthly cash flow to Magnum's net interest of about $30,000, the company said.
